subject: mathematics
concept: Real-world multi-step word problems involving Law of Sines, Law of Cosines, or periodic trig functions, using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore Model Method (bar modeling) principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student solves a realistic scenario (navigation, surveying, tidal or seasonal pattern) using non-right triangle or periodic trig tools
exercise.pictorial: Student draws and labels a diagram representing the problem before solving
exercise.abstract: Student solves a multi-step real-world trigonometry word problem and explains their reasoning

misconception_flags: cannot identify whether the problem requires Law of Sines, Law of Cosines, or a periodic function model

interest_binding: word problems generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
